Static lock-off three-quarter beauty frame holds on @Image2 facing camera. She slowly presses her coral lips together once, seal unbroken by wind. Then she turns her head slightly toward the open horizon, a quiet certain grin forming as she softens her gaze. Golden light rim continues, blonde hair lifts gently in the breeze, linen shirt flutters lightly. Sparkling airborne motes drift around her as distant waves roll in behind.

soft ocean waves rolling onto shore, gentle sea breeze, distant gull cries. light fabric flutter of linen shirt, soft wet sand kiss of distant surf.

Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
